summary_md: **Yuki｜AIと個人開発 ([@uk_indiehack_JP](https://x.com/uk_indiehack_JP/status/2115931693446201412))** notes that AI-written Rust often compiles but stays C++-minded, and points to **BeautifulRust**, a plugin with vetted clippy settings that teaches Claude Code and four other agents idiomatic Rust ([morganlinton/BeautifulRust](https://github.com/morganlinton/BeautifulRust)).
